title: Heading of the Settings section, and title of the dialog listing the person's archived chats (chats hidden from the sidebar, not deleted).
empty: Shown when the person has no archived chats.
summary: How many archived chats the person has.
manage: Button that opens the dialog listing the archived chats.
description: "⌘K palette" is the quick search opened with Command-K (Ctrl-K); keep "⌘K". Scheduled tasks are tasks socios (AI agents) run on a schedule in those chats.
none: Shown in the Archived chats dialog when it has nothing to list.
list: Accessible name of the list of archived chats (read by screen readers).
row: Under an archived chat's title: {{socio}} is the name of the socio (AI agent) the chat is with, and <date></date> is replaced by the date it was archived (see date). The _noSocio form is for chats without one. Keep the <date></date> tag; move it where your language puts the date.
date: The date a chat was archived, medium length ("Oct 12, 2026").
unarchive: Tooltip of the button that puts the chat back in the sidebar.
unarchiveLabel: Accessible name of the Unarchive button; {{title}} is the chat's title.
delete: Tooltip of the button that deletes the chat for good (after a confirmation).
deleteLabel: Accessible name of the Delete button; {{title}} is the chat's title.
